flows.title: View lead performance for a campaign
steps: Go to your ad account in Campaign Manager. Viewing lead performance needs Viewer access or higher on the ad account.
Click Advertise on the left menu.
Select Conversion & Leads from the Columns dropdown of the performance table to see the metrics for each ad set.
Click the Filters dropdown to filter the ad sets by Status, Type of ad or Objective.

flows.title: Download the leads from a Lead Gen Form
steps: Go to your ad account in Campaign Manager. Downloading leads needs Viewer access or higher on the ad account and Lead Gen Forms manager or higher on the Company Page.
Click Content & Assets on the left menu, then click Lead generation forms.
Select the checkbox next to one or more Lead Gen Forms.
Click the time range dropdown arrow in the right corner and choose a Start date and End date, or a pre-populated range from the left of the pop-up window.
Click the Download leads button, then click Download in the pop-up window. The leads download as a CSV file, one per form.
